title: 2027 sign-ups
hint: When can families register, and what will it cost?
prompts: Opening and closing dates
Age groups, fees and what is included
Discounts, payment plans and registration link

title: Club contacts
prompts: Registrar and general enquiries: name, email and phone
Who will help test the website?
Who manages the club website address and Google Maps account?

title: Teams, training and games
hint: Send the details you have so far.
prompts: Team names, age groups and coaches
Training days, times and locations
Fixture draw and Google Maps links for the grounds

title: News and events
hint: What would you like families to see?
prompts: News stories or announcements
Event name, date, time and location
Photos, with a short description of where each belongs

title: Uniforms and merchandise
hint: Tell us what the club will sell.
prompts: Product names, prices and photos
Available sizes, colours and quantity of each
Supplier details and size charts

title: Payments and collection
hint: How will families pay and receive their orders?
prompts: Collection location, times and contact
Payment methods on collection and who manages online payments
Delivery or preorders, if needed; exchange and refund rules

title: Club photos and sponsors
hint: Add the pictures and logos you want on the site.
prompts: Club logos, grounds and general club photos
Sponsor names, logos and website links
Photo captions and where each image should appear

title: Final checks
hint: Let us know who will check everything before opening.
prompts: Approved admins, coaches and committee members
Contact for safety reports or account misuse
Who will review the registration, consent and account-use wording?
Anything you found while testing that needs fixing
